name: Apple Inc.
summary: Apple Inc. designs, makes and sells smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables and accessories around the world. Its products include the iPhone, Mac and iPad, along with AirPods, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Apple Vision Pro, Beats and HomePod. It also offers AppleCare support, cloud services and platforms such as the App Store for apps and digital content.

name: Abaxx Technologies Inc.
summary: Abaxx Technologies, Inc., a financial software company, develops software tools for commodity traders and finance professionals to communicate, trade, and transact. It provides trading and clearing software, financial messaging and data services, and digital identity and access management software. The company also engages in the development of a regulated commodity futures exchange. The company is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Atco Ltd/Canada
summary: ATCO Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides housing, logistics and transportation, agriculture, water, real estate, and energy and energy infrastructure solutions in Canada, Australia, and internationally. The company offers workforce and residential housing; modular facilities; construction and site support; workforce lodging; facility operations and maintenance; defense operations; and disaster and emergency management services. It also provides commercial real estate services, including sale of commercial and industrial properties; and bulk cargo and port operation services, as well as operates container port facilities. The company's portfolio includes 15 commercial real estate properties, including 417,000 square feet of office property, 90,000 square feet of industrial property, and 315 acres of land. In addition, it engages in electricity generation, distribution, transmission, and related infrastructure services; natural gas distribution; owns and operates natural gas transmission pipelines in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and northern regions of Canada, as well as in Western Australia; and builds, owns, and operates non-regulated industrial water, natural gas storage, natural gas liquids storage, and natural gas related infrastructure to serve the midstream and petrochemical sectors. Further, it sells electricity and natural gas to residential and commercial customers; and provides natural gas appliance demonstrations and small cooking schools for homemakers. ATCO Ltd. was founded in 1947 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Adobe Inc.
summary: Adobe Inc. operates as a diversified software company worldwide. Its Digital Media segment provides tools and solutions that enable individuals, teams, and enterprises to create, publish, promote, and monetize their digital content. Its flagship product is Creative Cloud, a subscription service that allows customer to download and access the latest versions of its creative products. This segment serves content creators, experience designers, app developers, enthusiasts, students, social media users, and creative professionals; and marketing departments and agencies, companies, and publishers. The company's Digital Experience segment offers products, services, and solutions for creating, managing, executing, measuring, monetizing, and optimizing customer experiences from analytics to commerce. This segment serves marketers, advertisers, agencies, publishers, merchandisers, merchants, web analysts, data scientists, developers, marketing executives, information management and technology executives, product development executives, and sales and support executives. Its Publishing and Advertising segment offers products and services, such as e-learning solutions, technical document publishing, web conferencing, document and forms platform, web application development, and high-end printing, as well as publishing needs of technical and business, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) printing businesses. The company offers its products and services directly to enterprise customers through its sales force and local field offices, as well as to end users through app stores and through its website at adobe.com. It also distributes products and services through a network of distributors, value-added resellers, systems integrators, software vendors and developers, retailers, and OEMs. The company was formerly known as Adobe Systems Incorporated and changed its name to Adobe Inc. in October 2018. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
summary: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. is a semiconductor company operating internationally in Data Center, Client and Gaming, and Embedded segments. Its products include graphics processing units, microprocessors and AI accelerators, along with semi-custom system-on-chip products and embedded processors. This listing is a CAD-hedged Canadian depositary receipt.

name: Amazon.com, Inc.
summary: Amazon.com, Inc. provides online retail shopping services and describes itself as a multinational technology firm. It reports in North America, International and Amazon Web Services (AWS) segments; the North America segment covers retail sales, advertising and subscription services through online and physical stores. This listing is a CAD-hedged Canadian depositary receipt.

name: Base Carbon Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Toronto, Canada, Base Carbon Inc. specializes in empowering projects within the voluntary carbon markets and the broader Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) sector. The company provides crucial financial backing, development knowledge, and operational management support to these initiatives.

name: BlackRock, Inc.
summary: BlackRock, Inc. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm primarily provides its services to institutional, intermediary, and individual investors including corporate, public, union, and industry pension plans, insurance companies, third-party mutual funds, endowments, public institutions, governments, foundations, charities, sovereign wealth funds, corporations, official institutions, and banks. It also provides global risk management and advisory services. The firm manages separate client-focused equity, fixed income, and balanced portfolios. It also launches and manages open-end and closed-end mutual funds, offshore funds, unit trusts, and alternative investment vehicles including structured funds. The firm launches equity, fixed income, balanced, and real estate mutual funds. It also launches equity, fixed income, balanced, currency, commodity, and multi-asset exchange traded funds. The firm also launches and manages hedge funds. It invests in the public equity, fixed income, real estate, currency, commodity, and alternative markets across the globe. The firm primarily invests in growth and value stocks of small-cap, mid-cap, SMID-cap, large-cap, and multi-cap companies. It also invests in dividend-paying equity securities. The firm invests in investment grade municipal securities, government securities including securities issued or guaranteed by a government or a government agency or instrumentality, corporate bonds, and asset-backed and mortgage-backed securities. It employs fundamental and quantitative analysis with a focus on bottom-up and top-down approach to make its investments. The firm employs liquidity, asset allocation, balanced, real estate, and alternative strategies to make its investments. In real estate sector, it seeks to invest in Poland and Germany. The firm benchmarks the performance of its portfolios against various S&P, Russell, Barclays, MSCI, Citigroup, and Merrill Lynch indices. BlackRock, Inc. was founded in 1988 and is based in New York City with additional offices in Boston, Massachusetts; London, United Kingdom; Gurgaon, India; Hong Kong; Greenwich, Connecticut; Princeton, New Jersey; Edinburgh, United Kingdom; Sydney, Australia; Taipei, Taiwan; Singapore; Sao Paulo, Brazil; Philadelphia, Pennsylvania; Washington, District of Columbia; Toronto, Canada; Wilmington, Delaware; and San Francisco, California.

name: Bank of America Corporation
summary: Bank of America Corporation is a financial holding company and bank providing banking as well as non-bank financial services. Its segments are Consumer Banking, Global Wealth and Investment Management, Global Banking, Global Markets and All Other. Consumer Banking provides credit, banking and investment products to individuals and small businesses, while wealth management covers investment, brokerage, banking and retirement products.

name: Berkshire Hathaway Inc.
summary: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. is a holding company with subsidiaries in insurance, freight rail transportation and utilities. It sells insurance and reinsurance across property, casualty, life, health and accident lines, runs North American railroads, and generates and distributes electricity from a mix of fuel sources. It also operates natural gas distribution, storage and pipeline facilities.

name: Mercer Park Brand Acquisition Corp.
summary: Mercer Park Brand Acquisition Corp. does not have significant operations. It intends to effect an acquisition of one or more businesses or assets by way of a merger, amalgamation, arrangement, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or any other similar business combination involving the Corporation in cannabis and/or cannabis-adjacent industries. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

name: BTQ Technologies Corp.
summary: BTQ Technologies Corp. is dedicated to creating advanced computing technology focused on post-quantum cryptography, primarily for its application within blockchain and related digital systems. The company's product suite features: PQScale: A scaling solution designed for lattice-based post-quantum signatures, which utilizes zero-knowledge proofs to compress digital signatures, thereby enhancing speed and reducing costs. Keelung: A user-friendly development toolkit for zero-knowledge proofs, which includes a domain-specific language integrated into Haskell and a compiler. Kenting: Specializes in hardware acceleration specifically optimized for zero-knowledge computation tasks. Quantum Proof-of-Work (QPoW): An energy-efficient, post-classical consensus algorithm that employs Noisy Intermediate Scale Quantum (NISQ) hardware to validate blockchain transactions. Furthermore, BTQ offers: QRiNG: A toolkit for generating quantum random numbers. Preon: A foundational component for a future-proof, digitally secure post-quantum signature scheme. QByte: A tool designed to calculate quantum risks. Established in 1983, BTQ Technologies Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Columbia Care Inc.
summary: Columbia Care Inc. cultivates, manufactures, and provides cannabis-based health and wellness solutions, and derivative products. The company holds licenses in 19 jurisdictions in the United States and the European Union. It operates cultivation facilities, manufacturing facilities, and retail dispensaries. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

name: Choice Consolidation Corp
summary: Choice Consolidation Corp., a special purpose acquisition corporation, intends to effect a merger, amalgamation, arrangement, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization, or related business combination with one or more businesses or assets. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

name: Tokens.com Corp.
summary: Tokens.com Inc., a blockchain technology company, provides transaction processing and validation services for various digital assets using proof-of-stake or staking technology. The company develops decentralized finance applications that provides automated and transparent financial services, such as borrowing and lending; and non-fungible token platforms that redefines how art, gaming, music, and collectibles are created, valued, and traded. The company is based in Toronto, Canada.

name: The Coca-Cola Company
summary: The Coca-Cola Company manufactures and markets non-alcoholic beverages, reporting results by region (Europe/Middle East/Africa, Latin America, North America, Asia Pacific) plus Global Ventures and Bottling Investments. Asa Griggs Candler founded it on May 8, 1886, and its headquarters are in Atlanta.

name: Costco Wholesale Corporation
summary: Costco Wholesale Corporation and its subsidiaries operate membership warehouses across fifteen countries and territories, among them the United States, Canada, Mexico, Japan, the UK, Korea, Australia and Puerto Rico. The warehouses sell groceries, deli items, liquor and tobacco, plus appliances, electronics, hardware, tires, toys, apparel, furniture and jewelry.

name: Salesforce, Inc.
summary: Salesforce, Inc. designs and develops enterprise software delivered through the cloud for managing customer relationships. Its offerings span marketing automation, sales automation, digital commerce, collaboration, community management, industry-specific solutions, service and support tools and a platform, backed by training, support and advisory services. It was founded in 1999 by Marc Benioff and Parker Harris and has its base in San Francisco.

name: Cisco Systems Inc
summary: Cisco Systems, Inc. designs, manufactures and sells Internet Protocol-based networking products and services aimed at the information technology and communications industry. It reports by region: the Americas, EMEA and APJC. Its product categories include secure and agile networks, collaboration, end-to-end security and optimized application experiences. It was founded in 1984 by Sandra Lerner and Leonard Bosack and has its head office in San Jose, California.

name: Cybin Inc.
summary: Cybin Inc., a life sciences company, focuses on developing psychedelic therapeutics to treat various psychiatric and neurological conditions. The company operates through two segments, Serenity Life and Natures Journey. The Serenity Life segment engages in the research and development of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical psilocybin products. The Natures Journey segment focuses on non-psychedelic medical mushroom nutraceutical products. The company offers its products through various form factors, such as capsules, powders, and effervescent tablets. Cybin Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: DeFi Technologies Inc.
summary: DeFi Technologies Inc. engages in the building and management of assets in the decentralized finance sector in Canada. It focuses on the enhancement of shareholder value through various investments, including the acquisition of DeFi protocols, equity, debt, or other securities of publicly traded or private companies, or other entities. The company was formerly known as Routemaster Capital Inc. and changed its name to DeFi Technologies Inc. in February 2021. DeFi Technologies Inc. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Digi Power X Inc.
summary: Digi Power X Inc. is an AI infrastructure company that operates a vertically integrated portfolio of power assets and data centers across the United States. The company, formerly focused on cryptocurrency mining, now develops data centers and provides GPU-as-a-Service through its NeoCloudz platform. It operates facilities in states including Alabama, New York, and North Carolina.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: The Walt Disney Company
summary: Operating globally, The Walt Disney Company stands as a leading entertainment conglomerate, encompassing a vast array of subsidiaries. Its operations are segmented into two core divisions: Disney Media and Entertainment Distribution, and Disney Parks, Experiences and Products. Disney is deeply involved in the creation and dissemination of both cinematic and episodic television content. This includes running numerous television networks such as ABC, Disney Channel, ESPN, Freeform, FX, Fox, National Geographic, and Star, alongside its renowned film studios like Walt Disney Pictures, Twentieth Century Studios, Marvel, Lucasfilm, Pixar, and Searchlight Pictures. The company extends its reach through a suite of direct-to-consumer streaming platforms, including Disney+, Disney+ Hotstar, ESPN+, Hulu, and Star+. Additionally, it licenses its film and television library to external broadcasters and subscription video-on-demand providers, handles theatrical releases, home entertainment sales, and music distribution. Disney is also active in staging and licensing live entertainment productions, and provides specialized post-production services via Industrial Light & Magic and Skywalker Sound. Beyond media, Disney manages a portfolio of iconic theme parks and resorts globally, including Walt Disney World in Florida, Disneyland Resort in California, Disneyland Paris, Hong Kong Disneyland Resort, and Shanghai Disney Resort. Its travel and leisure offerings also feature the Disney Cruise Line, Disney Vacation Club, National Geographic Expeditions, Adventures by Disney, and Aulani, a resort and spa located in Hawaii. Moreover, Disney licenses its intellectual property for the operation of Tokyo Disney Resort. Its extensive consumer products division encompasses licensing trade names, characters, and various visual and literary IPs for a wide range of merchandise, published works, and games. The company also oversees a direct-to-home satellite distribution network, distributes its branded goods through retail stores, online platforms, and wholesale channels, and publishes books, comic books, and magazines. Established in 1923, The Walt Disney Company maintains its headquarters in Burbank, California.

name: Denarius Metals Corp.
summary: DENARIUS METALS CORP is a Canadian exploration company focused on the discovery, development, and acquisition of polymetallic mineral deposits. The company's focus is on exploration in Spain. Denarius Metals is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

name: Elys Game Technology, Corp.
summary: Elys Game Technology, Corp. provides online and land-based gaming services in Europe and North America. It offers leisure betting products, including lottery, casino gaming, sports betting, online casino games, poker, bingo, virtual sports betting, and horse racing, as well as skilled and interactive games and slots; and operates betting platform software services for leisure betting establishments. The company provides its products through physical, land-based retail locations; website, newgioco.it or commercial webskins linked to its website; and mobile devices under under the Newgioco brand name, as well as under the trade names of NewAleabet, OriginalBet, LovingBet, and Elys. It serves 100,000 online user accounts through 1,000 Web cafés, 7 corners, and 113 agency/ data transmission center locations. The company was formerly known as Newgioco Group, Inc. and changed its name to Elys Game Technology, Corp. in November 2020. Elys Game Technology, Corp. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Ether Capital Corporation
summary: Ether Capital Corporation, a technology company, through its subsidiaries, provides access and exposure to the Ethereum and Web 3 ecosystem to public market investors. It also operates cryptocurrency exchange and technology platform. The company was formerly known as Movit Media Corp. Ether Capital Corporation was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: FAIRCOURT SPLIT TRUST - UNITS
summary: FAIRCOURT SPLIT TRUST - UNITS is a Canadian investment fund that aims to provide holders of units with fixed cumulative preferential monthly cash distributions and to return the original issue price to unitholders on the termination date. The trust invests primarily in a portfolio of dividend-paying common shares of Canadian corporations. It is managed by Faircourt Asset Management Inc.

name: Faircourt Gold Income Corp.
summary: Faircourt Gold Income Corp. is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by Faircourt Asset Management Inc. It invests in the public equity markets of Canada. The fund seeks to invest in stocks of companies operating in the precious metals sector, with an emphasis on companies involved in gold mining and exploration. It primarily invests in stocks of senior and intermediate gold producers that are part of the S&P/TSX Global Gold Index. The fund benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against S&P/TSX Global Gold Index. Faircourt Gold Income Corp. was formed on November 16, 2007 and is domiciled in Canada.

name: Fortis Inc/Canada
summary: Fortis Inc. is a prominent North American utility enterprise, delivering essential electricity and natural gas services across Canada, the United States, and various Caribbean nations. In the realm of electricity, the company supplies power to roughly 438,000 retail consumers in southeastern Arizona and an additional 100,000 retail customers in Arizona's Mohave and Santa Cruz counties. Beyond retail operations, Fortis is also a wholesale electricity vendor to other entities throughout the western United States. Regarding its natural gas operations, Fortis serves approximately 1,065,000 residential, commercial, and industrial clients in British Columbia, Canada. In other Canadian territories, Fortis manages the electricity distribution network for approximately 577,000 customers across southern and central Alberta. The utility also ensures electricity supply to the island portion of Newfoundland and Labrador, and to Prince Edward Island. Its integrated electric utility services extend to customers in Ontario, Newfoundland and Labrador, Grand Cayman in the Cayman Islands, and Turks and Caicos. Internationally, Fortis holds long-term contracts for generation assets in Belize and owns the Aitken Creek natural gas storage facility. Fortis Inc. was established in 1885 and maintains its corporate headquarters in St. John's, Canada.

name: Alphabet Inc.
summary: Alphabet Inc. is a holding company with interests in software, health care, transportation and other technologies. Its Google Services unit includes advertising, Android, Chrome, Maps, Play, Search and YouTube, Google Cloud sells infrastructure, platform and collaboration services to businesses, and Other Bets covers healthcare and internet ventures.

name: TPCO Holding Corp.
summary: TPCO Holding Corp., cultivates, manufactures, distributes, and retails cannabis in California. The company offers approximately 17 owned and licensed brands offering 250 SKUs across various factors, such as whole flower, pre-rolls, infused pre-rolls, vaporizer cartridges, concentrates, gummies, chocolate, beverages, capsules, tinctures, lozenges, topicals, and body care products. It also offers its products through Caliva.com, a direct-to-consumer e-commerce platform. The company was formerly known as Subversive Capital Acquisition Corp. and changed its name to TPCO Holding Corp. in January 2021. TPCO Holding Corp. was incorporated in 2019 and is based in San Jose, California.

name: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.
summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. supplies financial services through three businesses: banking and markets worldwide, asset and wealth management, and platform solutions. Activities include investment banking, equity and debt investing, consumer deposits and lending, credit card partnerships, point-of-sale financing and transaction banking.

name: GetSwift Technologies Limited
summary: Getswift Technologies Limited operates as a technology and services company. The company provides a suite of software, products, and services that are focused on business and logistics and automation, data management and analysis, communications, information security, and infrastructure optimization; and ecommerce and marketplace ordering, workforce management, data analytics and augmentation, business intelligence, route optimization, cash management, task management shift management, asset track, real-time alerts, cloud communications, and communications infrastructure services and products through consulting, design, construction, and maintenance. It serves public and private sector clients across various industries and jurisdictions for their respective logistics, communications, information security, and infrastructure projects and operations in Australia, the United States, and internationally. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in New York, New York.

name: The Home Depot, Inc.
summary: The Home Depot, Inc. operates as a leading retailer specializing in home improvement. Its namesake stores offer a comprehensive selection of products, including building materials, a wide range of home renovation supplies, lawn and garden essentials, decorative items, and goods for facilities maintenance, repair, and operations. Beyond its retail offerings, the company provides professional installation services for key household features such as flooring, cabinetry (including refacing options), countertops, heating and cooling systems, and windows. Customers can also access tool and equipment rental services. The Home Depot caters to a diverse clientele, primarily serving individual homeowners, alongside a variety of professional contractors, renovators, property managers, maintenance personnel, handymen, and specialized tradespeople like electricians and plumbers. Its products are also available through multiple online channels, including its flagship website, homedepot.com, as well as blinds.com for custom window treatments and thecompanystore.com for textiles and home décor. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, The Home Depot, Inc. was established in 1978. As of December 31, 2021, the company maintained a network of 2,317 retail locations throughout the United States.

name: Immutable Holdings Inc.
summary: Immutable Holdings Inc. operates as a blockchain technology holding company. The company develops, owns, and operates NFT.com platform, a one-stop shop for non-fungible tokens; HBAR.com, a community portal to the Hedera Hashgraph network and its native platform token HBAR; and MyHbarWallet.com, an open-source wallet and client-side interface that helps users to interact with the Hedera Hashgraph network. Immutable Holdings Inc. is headquartered in San Juan, Puerto Rico.

name: International Business Machines Corporation
summary: International Business Machines Corp. is an information technology company providing integrated solutions that combine technology with knowledge of business processes. It reports Software, Consulting, Infrastructure, Financing and Other segments. Software combines hybrid cloud platforms and software to help clients use data, automate, secure and modernise, while Consulting integrates strategy, technology and operations skills.

name: Intel Corporation
summary: Intel Corp. designs, manufactures and sells computer products and technologies, delivering platforms for computing, communications, data storage and networking. Its segments are Client Computing Group, Data Center and AI, Intel Foundry Services, and All Other. Client Computing covers platforms for notebooks, desktops, tablets and phones, plus wireless and wired connectivity products.

name: Global Crossing Airlines Group Inc.
summary: Global Crossing Airlines Inc. operates in the airline business. It focuses to fly as an aircraft, crew, maintenance, and insurance (ACMI) and wet lease charter airline serving the United States, Caribbean, and Latin American markets. The company is headquartered in Miami, Florida.

name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a financial holding company offering financial and investment banking services, including consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, transaction processing and asset management. Its segments are Consumer and Community Banking, Commercial and Investment Bank, Asset and Wealth Management, and Corporate. The first originates and services mortgage loans, while the second makes markets and serves clients across fixed income.

name: Kontrol Technologies Corp.
summary: Kontrol Technologies Corp. provides energy efficiency solutions and technologies to commercial energy consumers in Canada and the United States. It offers SmartSite, a software as a service platform; SmartSuite, connect into existing building automation systems and to also communicate with utilities; cogeneration or combined heat and power, and other mechanical equipment installation; smart energy management systems installation; energy retrofits; energy auditing, monitoring and verification, energy project assessment, and mechanical, electrical, and renewable design services; and GHG measurement and verification services, such as stack and continuous emission testing, power generation, compliance, consulting, and other engineering services. The company also provides engineering and mechanical services to industrial, municipal, and commercial building owners; and engineering consulting services, including greenhouse gas reporting, air quality testing, emission testing, and renewable energy/power consulting. It serves manufacturing, utilities, cannabis, and education sectors, as well as commercial and multi-residential buildings. The company was formerly known as Kontrol Energy Corp. and changed its name to Kontrol Technologies Corp. in February 2021. Kontrol Technologies Corp. is headquartered in Vaughan, Canada.

name: Lululemon Athletica Inc.
summary: Lululemon Athletica Inc. designs, distributes and retails technical athletic clothing, shoes and accessories. It reports Company-Operated Stores, Direct to Consumer and Other segments. It was founded in 1998 by Dennis James Wilson and has its head office in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Mastercard Incorporated
summary: Mastercard Incorporated operates as a global technology company, primarily focused on providing payment solutions and related services across the United States and internationally. It plays a crucial role in facilitating payment transactions by handling their authorization, clearing, and settlement. Beyond this core function, the company delivers a broad array of integrated products and value-added services to a diverse clientele, including individual consumers, merchants, financial institutions, businesses, and government organizations. These offerings feature programs that enable credit for deferred payments, comprehensive prepaid solutions, commercial credit and debit products, and tools that allow access to funds in various deposit accounts. Mastercard also enhances transaction security through its cyber and intelligence solutions and offers proprietary insights drawn from consumer and merchant data. For e-commerce enterprises, its extensive suite includes analytics, test and learn functionalities, consulting, managed services, loyalty programs, processing capabilities, and payment gateway solutions. Furthermore, the company is involved in open banking and digital identity platform services. Mastercard's services and products are recognized under the brands MasterCard, Maestro, and Cirrus. Founded in 1966, the company maintains its headquarters in Purchase, New York.

name: Maritime Launch Services Inc.
summary: Maritime Launch Services Inc. is a commercial space company, based in Halifax, Canada, with operations centered in Nova Scotia. The company is actively developing Spaceport Nova Scotia, a dedicated launch facility that will offer satellite deployment services. This initiative aims to enable clients in the commercial space transportation industry to successfully place their satellites into low-earth orbit.

name: Medcolcanna Organics Inc.
summary: Medcolcanna Organics Inc. is a Canadian-based company focused on the cultivation, processing, and distribution of cannabis and hemp products for medicinal and industrial purposes. They operate in Colombia and other regions, aiming to supply high-quality cannabis extracts and finished products to global markets. The company's headquarters are located in Toronto, Canada.

name: Medivolve Inc.
summary: Medivolve Inc. is a principal investment firm. It is a social-impact investment focused company Investing resources, funds and bandwidth for the betterment of the human condition through medical sciences, climate change and technology. The firm was formerly known as Continent Resources Inc. and changed its name to Copper One Inc. in October 2009. Copper One Inc. was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: Meta Platforms, Inc.
summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. develops social media applications and technology to help people stay connected and share, locate communities and expand their own businesses. It reports Family of Apps and Reality Labs segments. The first includes Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp, while Reality Labs covers augmented, mixed and virtual reality hardware, software and content. It was founded in 2004.

name: Maple Leaf Green World Inc.
summary: Maple Leaf Green World Inc., together with its subsidiaries, focuses on the cannabis and industry in North America. The company was formerly known as Maple Leaf Reforestation Inc. and changed its name to Maple Leaf Green World Inc. in October 2012. Maple Leaf Green World Inc. is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Mount Logan Capital Inc.
summary: Mount Logan Capital Inc.is an investment firm primarily focused on investing in public and private debt securities. The Company holds and actively manages and monitors a seed portfolio of loans and other investments with credit-oriented characteristics. The company was formerly known as Marret Resource Corp. and changed its name to Mount Logan Capital Inc. in October 2018. Mount Logan Capital Inc. is based in New York, New York.

name: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited
summary: McFarlane Lake Mining Limited is a Canadian company specializing in the acquisition, exploration, and development of gold deposits. Its current holdings include an option agreement for a 100% interest in the High Lake mineral property, positioned east of the Ontario-Manitoba border. The company also maintains interests in the West Hawk Lake mineral property in Southwestern Manitoba, the McMillan and Mongowin properties in Northeastern Ontario, and the Michaud/Munro properties near Matheson, Ontario. McFarlane Lake Mining Limited operates from its head office in Sudbury, Canada.

name: Mind Medicine (MindMed) Inc.
summary: Mind Medicine (MindMed) Inc., a psychedelic medicine biotech company, discovers, develops, and deploys psychedelic inspired medicines and therapies to address addiction and mental illness. The company is assembling a compelling drug development pipeline of innovative treatments based on psychedelic substances, including Psilocybin, LSD, MDMA, DMT, and an Ibogaine derivative, 18-MC. The company is headquartered in New York, New York.

name: Merida Merger Corp. I
summary: Merida Merger Corp. I does not have significant operations. It intends to enter into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, stock purchase, recapitalization, reorganization, or other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities in the cannabis industry. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in New York, New York.

name: Greenland Resources Inc.
summary: Greenland Resources Inc. acquires, explores and develops mineral projects, with a focus on its Malmbjerg molybdenum project in eastern Greenland. It was founded in 2008 by Ruben Shiffman and has its head office in Toronto, Canada.

name: Clean Power Capital Corp.
summary: Clean Power Capital Corp. is a venture capital firm specializing in investments in early stage, buyouts. It prefers to invest in equity, bridge loans, secured loans, unsecured loans, convertible debentures, warrants and options, joint ventures, partnerships, royalties, streaming investments, net profit interests and other hybrid instruments. It focuses its investments in energy sector, oil and gas equipment and commercial aircraft sector. The firm prefers to invest in securities of private and publicly listed entities that are involved in a variety of industries including renewable energy includes hydrogen & fuel cell technologies, wind power, solar power and geothermal power. The firm invests bio-medical, pharmaceutical, and naturopathic sectors, which may include medical or recreational cannabis. The firm prefers to focus on investing in cannabis enterprises. The firm considers investments in North America. The firm does not invest in Canada and United States. The firm takes control position and majority stake in the companies. Clean Power Capital Corp. was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada with additional offices in Hamilton, Bermuda and London, United Kingdom.

name: Microsoft Corporation
summary: Microsoft Corporation develops and supports technology solutions used by individuals and businesses around the world. Its products cover operating systems, business and server applications, software development and management tools and video games, as well as devices such as PCs, tablets and consoles. Its Productivity and Business Processes segment includes Microsoft 365 Commercial, Power BI, Exchange and SharePoint.

name: Mydecine Innovations Group Inc.
summary: Mydecine Innovations Group Inc. operates as a biopharma and life sciences company which focuses on research, development, acceptance, and commercialization of alternative nature-sourced medicine for treating mental health problems. Its mental health solutions focuses on clinical trials focusing on veterans; emergency medical services (EMS); first responders with a PTSD indication; and drug discovery and delivery mechanisms. The company develops digital health solutions, such as digital therapeutics and quantified mental health solutions. Additionally, it engages in the operation of real estate and farm properties in North America. Mydecine has partnership with Applied Pharmaceutical Innovation for drug development and clinical trial programs. The company was formerly known as NewLeaf Brands Inc. and changed its name to Mydecine Innovations Group Inc. in June 2020. Mydecine Innovations Group Inc. is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Carbon Streaming Corporation
summary: Carbon Streaming Corporation, an investment vehicle, provides investors with the exposure to carbon credits. It intends to build a portfolio of carbon credits for the compliance and voluntary markets. The company was formerly known as Mexivada Mining Corp. and changed its name to Carbon Streaming Corporation in June 2020. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.

name: Netflix, Inc.
summary: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services. It offers TV series, documentaries, and feature films across various genres and languages. The company provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of Internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, television set-top boxes, and mobile devices. It also provides DVDs-by-mail membership services. The company has approximately 204 million paid members in 190 countries. Netflix, Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.

name: NIKE, Inc.
summary: NIKE, Inc. designs, develops, markets and sells athletic shoes, clothing, accessories, equipment and services. Its segments are North America, EMEA, Greater China, Asia Pacific and Latin America, Global Brand Divisions, Converse and Corporate. Global Brand Divisions covers licensing of the NIKE Brand.

name: NexTech AR Solutions Corp.
summary: NexTech AR Solutions Corp. engages in the acquisition and development of augmented reality (AR) technology. The company offers ARitize eCommerce, the browser-based and Web enabled AR shopping platform; NexTech University, an app-based solution that allows companies and educational establishments to leverage their existing 2D assets and overlay immersive 3D-AR experiences on top of that content for an interactive training experience; NexTech Studios for branded entertainment and immersive 360 experiences; NexTech 3D/AR-360, an end-to-end solution; and ARitize360 that gives customers an interactive experience by transforming their products into AR models, as well as CaptureAR, an AR technology that makes 3D augmented reality creation accessible. In addition, the company sells vacuum cleaners and parts through retail stores and online sales channels; and health supplements for animals through online sales channels. NexTech AR Solutions Corp. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.

name: NVIDIA Corporation
summary: NVIDIA Corporation operates as a visual computing company worldwide. It operates in two segments, Graphics and Compute & Networking. The Graphics segment offers GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, the GeForce NOW game streaming service and related infrastructure, and solutions for gaming platforms; Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise design; GRID software for cloud-based visual and virtual computing; and automotive platforms for infotainment systems. The Compute & Networking segment offers Data Center platforms and systems for AI, HPC, and accelerated computing; Mellanox networking and interconnect solutions; automotive AI Cockpit, autonomous driving development agreements, and autonomous vehicle solutions; and Jetson for robotics and other embedded platforms. The company's products are used in gaming, professional visualization, datacenter, and automotive markets. NVIDIA Corporation sells its products to original equipment manufacturers, original device manufacturers, system builders, add-in board manufacturers, retailers/distributors, Internet and cloud service providers, automotive manufacturers and tier-1 automotive suppliers, mapping companies, start-ups, and other ecosystem participants. NVIDIA Corporation was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

name: Onco-Innovations Limited
summary: Onco-Innovations Limited, a pre-clinical stage biotechnology company, develops drug candidates for cancer treatments. The company's lead product candidate is ONC010, a novel inhibitor of the DNA repair enzyme a Polynucleotide Kinase 3'-Phosphatase (PNKP) in a nanoparticle formulation based on the drug delivery technology. The company has a strategic collaboration with Nucro-Technics Inc. for the development of bioanalytical methods to support preclinical pharmacokinetic and biodistribution studies. Onco-Innovations Limited is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.

name: Palo Alto Networks, Inc.
summary: Palo Alto Networks, Inc. provides comprehensive cybersecurity solutions globally. The company's core product line features both hardware appliances and software for firewalls, alongside Panorama, a centralized security management platform available as a virtual or physical deployment to oversee network security. Its extensive subscription services encompass critical areas like advanced threat prevention, malware and persistent threat protection, URL filtering, security for laptops and mobile devices, DNS security, Internet of Things (IoT) security, and both API-based and inline Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) security, in addition to threat intelligence and data loss prevention. Furthermore, Palo Alto Networks offers specialized services for cloud security, secure access, security operations, and expert threat intelligence and consulting. Its professional services include architecture design and planning, implementation, configuration, and firewall migration, while education services offer certifications and training programs. Dedicated support services are also provided. The company distributes its products and services through channel partners and direct sales channels to a diverse clientele, including medium to large enterprises, service providers, and government organizations across various sectors such as education, energy, financial services, healthcare, Internet and media, manufacturing, public sector, and telecommunications. Incorporated in 2005, Palo Alto Networks, Inc. is based in Santa Clara, California.

name: Pfizer Inc.
summary: Pfizer Inc. is a global biopharmaceutical business built on research, which discovers, develops, makes, markets and distributes biopharmaceutical products worldwide across developed and emerging markets. It was founded in 1849 by Charles Pfizer Sr. and Charles Erhart and has its head office in New York.

name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
summary: Palantir Technologies Inc. engineers and provides advanced software solutions primarily for the intelligence sector, aiding in counterterrorism investigations and operational responses across the United States, United Kingdom, and internationally. Its key offerings include: Palantir Gotham: This platform is designed to unearth intricate patterns concealed within diverse datasets, ranging from signals intelligence to confidential reports. It facilitates a seamless transition of insights from analysts to field operators, empowering them to strategize and execute real-world interventions against identified threats. Palantir Foundry: Revolutionizing organizational data management, Foundry acts as a central operating system, enabling users to effortlessly integrate and analyze disparate data sources in one comprehensive environment. Palantir Apollo: This software ensures efficient delivery of applications and updates throughout an enterprise, allowing for flexible deployment in virtually any computing environment. Palantir Artificial Intelligence Platform: Offering consolidated access to open-source, self-hosted, and commercial large language models (LLMs), this platform converts both structured and unstructured data into LLM-interpretable objects, transforming organizational processes into actionable tools for human users and AI agents alike. In a strategic collaboration with Stagwell Inc., Palantir is also developing an AI-driven marketing platform. This initiative aims to harness the combined power of data and artificial intelligence to significantly enhance marketing return on investment. The company was founded in 2003 and its headquarters are located in Denver, Colorado.

name: PayPal Holdings, Inc.
summary: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates as a technology platform and digital payments company that enables digital and mobile payments on behalf of consumers and merchants worldwide. Its payment solutions include PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, and iZettle products. The company's payments platform allows consumers to send and receive payments, withdraw funds to their bank accounts, and hold balances in their PayPal accounts in various currencies. It also offers gateway services that enable merchants to accept payments online with credit or debit cards, as well as digital wallets. PayPal Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

name: Rheinmetall AG
summary: Rheinmetall AG is a Germany-based security technology and mobility group operating in Vehicle Systems, Weapon and Ammunition, Electronic Solutions, Sensors and Actuators, and Materials and Trade segments, producing military vehicles, weapons and ammunition, as well as automotive components. Founded in 1889, headquartered in Düsseldorf, Germany.

name: Starbucks Corporation
summary: Starbucks Corp. produces, markets and retails specialty coffee through North America, International and Channel Development segments. North America covers the United States and Canada, International spans markets such as China, Japan, Europe and Latin America, and Channel Development includes packaged roasted coffees, Seattle's Best Coffee and Teavana single-serve products.

name: Starlight Hybrid Global Real Assets Trust
summary: Starlight Hybrid Global Real Assets Trust is a real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on owning and operating a diversified portfolio of real estate assets. The trust's portfolio may include properties across various sectors, such as residential, commercial, and industrial. The trust aims to provide unitholders with stable returns through rental income and capital appreciation.

name: Super Micro Computer, Inc.
summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. develops and manufactures high-performance server and storage solutions based on modular and open architecture. The company offers a range of server management software and optimizes its products for various workloads, including AI, cloud, and 5G. Super Micro Computer is headquartered in San Jose, California.

name: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc.
summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. provides scientific services and products including life sciences solutions, analytical instruments, diagnostics, laboratory supplies and biopharmaceutical services, across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions. Its Life Sciences Solutions division supplies researchers with reagents, instruments and consumables for biological and medical research.

name: Tesla, Inc.
summary: Tesla, Inc. designs, develops, manufactures and sells electric vehicles, plus systems for energy generation and storage, through Automotive and Energy Generation and Storage segments. Automotive covers electric vehicle sales and leasing plus regulatory credits, while Energy Generation and Storage covers solar generation, energy storage products, installation, leasing and related services.

name: UnitedHealth Group Inc
summary: UnitedHealth Group, Inc. provides data consultancy and software services as well as health care coverage through UnitedHealthcare, OptumHealth, OptumInsight and OptumRx segments. UnitedHealthcare uses Optum's capabilities to coordinate patient care, improve affordability, analyze cost trends and manage pharmacy benefits, while OptumHealth provides health and wellness care to payers and others across the health care marketplace.

name: Visa Inc.
summary: Visa, Inc. provides digital payment services and facilitates commerce by moving value and information through a worldwide network that links consumers, merchants, banks and other financial institutions, companies, government bodies and strategic partners. Its offerings include debit, credit and prepaid cards, commercial payment solutions and ATMs worldwide. It was founded in 1958 by Dee Hock and has its head office in San Francisco, California.

name: Verano Holdings Corp.
summary: Verano Holdings Corp. operates as a vertically-integrated multi-state cannabis operator in the United States. The company produces and sells a suite of cannabis products under the portfolio of consumer brands, including Verano, Avexia, Encore, and MÜV. It designs, builds, and operates dispensaries under the Zen Leaf and MÜV retail brands that delivers a cannabis shopping experience in medical and adult-use markets. The company also holds, operates, manages, consults, licenses, and/or controls licenses/permits in the states of Illinois, Maryland, New Jersey, Massachusetts, Nevada, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Arkansas, California, Missouri, and West Virginia; and engages in the wholesale of cannabis consumer packaged goods. Verano Holdings Corp. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

name: Verizon Communications Inc
summary: Verizon Communications, Inc. is a holding company providing a range of communications, entertainment and information offerings through Consumer and Business segments. Consumer offers wireless and wireline services, while Business offers wireless and wireline services including fixed wireless broadband, data, video and conferencing, corporate networking, security and managed network services, and voice services.

name: Western Digital Corp.
summary: Western Digital Corp. develops, manufactures, markets and sells data storage devices and solutions, operating through a Hard Disk Drives segment. It was founded by Alvin B. Phillips in 1970 and has its head office in San Jose, California.

name: Walmart Inc.
summary: Walmart Inc. engages in the operation of retail, wholesale, and other units worldwide. The company operates through three segments: Walmart U.S., Walmart International, and Sam's Club. It operates supercenters, supermarkets, hypermarkets, warehouse clubs, cash and carry stores, and discount stores; membership-only warehouse clubs; ecommerce websites, such as walmart.com, walmart.com.mx, walmart.ca, flipkart.com, and samsclub.com; and mobile commerce applications. The company offers grocery products, including dry grocery, snacks, dairy, meat, produce, deli and bakery, frozen foods, and alcoholic and nonalcoholic beverages, as well as consumables, such as health and beauty aids, pet supplies, household chemicals, paper goods, and baby products; and health and wellness products covering pharmacy, over-the-counter drugs and other medical products, and optical and clinical services. It also provides gasoline stations and tobacco; home improvement, outdoor living, gardening, furniture, apparel, and jewelry, as well as tools and power equipment, housewares, toys, seasonal items, mattresses, and tire and battery centers; and consumer electronics and accessories, software, video games, office supplies, appliances, and third-party gift cards. In addition, the company offers fuel and financial services and related products, including money orders, prepaid cards, money transfers, and check cashing and bill payment. It operates approximately 11,400 stores and various e-commerce websites under 54 banners in 26 countries. The company was formerly known as Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. and changed its name to Walmart Inc. in February 2018. Walmart Inc. was founded in 1945 and is based in Bentonville, Arkansas.

name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. is an energy and petrochemical business with international reach that develops solutions meant to improve quality of life and meet society's changing needs. It is headquartered in Spring, Texas.
